summary: BCCI Tournament Wiring Audit — 10-step conformance run for BCCI-family tournaments (used seeded 'Duleep Trophy' tournament_type_code=bcci_staging → resolves to wiring type_id=bcci). Verified GET /api/tournament-wiring cell values vs actual API/UI behavior. Backend guards are 90% enforced but Step 1 (tournament_creation) is completely UN-guarded, and Step 6 (match_calendar) UI ships DROPDOWNS despite the wiring banner correctly displaying 'MANUAL TEAM NAMES — FREE-TEXT (E.G. AWAY = OTHER STATES) PER WIRING'. Backend accepts free-text team names — the divergence is UI-only for Step 6.

per_step_audit_table.root_cause: /app/backend/routes/tournaments.py:321 create_tournament() — no wiring guard. Only guard is in POST /tournaments/{tid}/status/{new_status} (line 595). Fix: add `await assert_wiring_owner(None, 'tournament_creation', x_body_type, ...)` but resolver needs to accept `tournament_type_code` directly (no tid yet). Suggest adding a variant `assert_wiring_owner_by_code(type_code, step, x_body_type)`.

critical.issue: No assert_wiring_owner('tournament_creation') guard — Division persona (X-Body-Type=Division, X-User-Body-Code=DIV-IND) successfully created a BCCI tournament (HTTP 200). Wiring cell says owner=MPCA. This is a governance leak across ALL 8 wiring types (Division could create MPCA-only BCCI/Inter-Div; District could create Division-only tournaments).

minor.issue: Cell text says 'HOST division only (one selectable)' but user's problem statement expects 'Manual — MPCA can add any body (e.g. Kerala, Karnataka) as opposing participant'. Wiring cell may be wrong OR pool_basics endpoint may not honor the Manual semantic. Needs product clarification + possible cell update.

ui_bugs.issue: TEAM A / TEAM B rendered as <select> dropdowns bound to `teamOptions` (registered bodies) even when wiring `match_calendar.mode === 'Manual_PDF'` (BCCI, School, Club, Camps, Coaching, Vacation types). User cannot enter free-text opponent names like 'Karnataka', 'Kerala', 'Other States'. Banner correctly announces free-text mode but form does not honor it. Confirmed on Duleep Trophy — Team A tag=<SELECT>, only option available was 'DIV-BPL'.

action_items: 1. FRONTEND FIX (Step 6, user-reported): In /app/frontend/src/components/MatchFixtureCard.jsx, read `useWiringStep(tournament.id, 'match_calendar')` and switch TEAM A / TEAM B from <select value=form.home_team> to <input type=text placeholder='e.g. Karnataka'> when cell.mode === 'Manual_PDF'. Ensure both create-mode and edit-mode branches switch. Consider also allowing free-text alongside dropdown when mode is 'Manual_PDF' (best UX = combobox / list with 'add new').

Because tid does not exist yet, resolve type_id from payload.tournament_type_code / tournament_type / scope using the existing _resolve_type_id helper (feed it the pending payload dict), fetch wiring cell for 'tournament_creation', then run the _OWNER_TO_BODY_TYPES check against X-Body-Type header. Alternatively: create a shared helper `assert_creation_owner(payload, x_body_type)` in core/wiring_guard.py.

3. VERIFICATION (Step 2 pool_basics): Confirm with product whether BCCI opposing teams should be Manual (free-text) or Register-linked. If Manual, update the wiring cell mode to Manual_PDF and update tournament_participations endpoint + PoolPanel UI accordingly.
4. VERIFICATION (Step 4 squad): Deep-test Squad panel end-to-end for BCCI — confirm signed-PDF upload flow works and register-selection is disabled when wiring mode=Manual_PDF.

rca_of_the_issue: USER-REPORTED BUG (Step 6): TournamentWorkspacePanels correctly reads `useWiringStep('match_calendar')` and renders the free-text banner when mode=Manual_PDF (line 210 of TournamentWorkspacePanels.jsx). However the *child* component that actually renders the form fields — MatchFixtureCard.jsx — hardcodes `<select data-testid=fx-team-a>` bound to `teamOptions` (line 271) and `<select data-testid=fx-team-b>` (line 285). No `mode` or `calStep` prop is passed to MatchFixtureCard. Consequence: banner + backend agree that BCCI should accept free-text 'Kerala', 'Karnataka', 'Other States', but the UI form only exposes registered MP bodies as picks. Fix requires (a) passing `calStep` (or `manualTeams=true`) from TournamentWorkspacePanels.jsx L275-303 into MatchFixtureCard, and (b) in MatchFixtureCard rendering conditional: if `manualTeams` → `<input type=text data-testid=fx-team-a value=form.home_team onChange=setField('home_team', e.target.value) />` (same for B), else keep existing dropdown. Reproduction confirmed via Playwright screenshot /app/test_reports/bcci_calendar_dropdown.png.
